data.name: Wima Magicamia Cute Girls Magic Battle 3DTPS
data.detailed_description:
[This game story language is in English.]

Cute Girls 3D-TPS of Magic Battle, "Wima Series" is created by personal creator.

Wima (Main Character / Boss in Chapter 1)

Although strongest wizard, she is aiming at a picture book author.

She can use flame magic which freely sniping enemy with magic scope.

When Tutorial, it will be battle of same chara by making magic clone.

Playable character in also Training Mode after defeating in boss battle of Chapter 1.

Somilia (Boss in Chapter 2)

Classmate of main chara. 1st opponent in Magic battle arena.

Although she behaved as cool,

From when she is called as "Cute" continuously by main chara,

she continues to be embarrassed while saying "It's not cute!" with her best.

Such a Story.

She will generate magic swords and do sting attacks by magic swords.

Playable character after defeating in boss battle of Chapter 2.

Menemu (Boss in Chapter 3)

Super singer idol girl. Semi-final opponent in Magic battle arena.

She can use strong magic from kick motion, power type chara.

By charging power with long time like axe kick's motion,

she can attack strong power magic of sticking out rock magic wave from ground.

If hit, it will be high damage.

Because she refused to hand over signed an autograph board to main character as fan,

as main character was interested in her rare shoes only.

On contrary, she becomes to handed over the autograph with her best.

Such a Story.

Playable character after defeating in boss battle of Chapter 3.

Lanyel (Boss in Chapter 4)

Final opponent in Magic battle arena.

When she using stopping time magic,

Opponent motion will be freeze by posture which it was doing motion at that time.

And Only Lanyel will move freely and she can do many times sticking attacks unilaterally by umbrella sticks toward enemy who stopped pose.

When at that time, if player is doing evasion action, you can evade her attacks.

Playable character after defeating in boss battle of Chapter 4.

Rabilwe (Boss in Chapter 5)

Fairy who summoned by main character's mother of magnificent magician.

She received mission from the mother which she will breed main character into a super magician.

But main character was already strongest magician from nature,

Because main character does not aim at magician persistently,

rabbit angel is so much in trouble not to achieve the mission.

Such a Story.

She can use magic of setting traps on land or air.

Playable character after defeating in boss battle of Chapter 5.

This 3D TPS Game is that Cute Girls will versus each other with magic attack.

While Pressing "X" Button, indicating Magic Circle,

By Drawing Magic Rune By Mouse, you can use magic of kinds which you drew the rune.

Drawing Fire's rune, you can use Fire's magic of Sniper Action.

Fire's magic is sniping action with magic aiming scope.

You can make enemy wince strong by this magic.

Drawing sword's rune, you can use Sword's magic of Chasing Enemy.

Magic swords will chase with high speed and sting.

Although not high damage,

because fast attack moreover enemy will wince, it's useful for battle.

One character can use three magic of personal.

By matching with battle situations, let's defeat enemy by using adaptable magic by drawing magic rune!

If you defeat boss, you can use new character in Story mode or Training Mode.

Each one series, main character(Wima) and other new four cute characters will be playable characters(Total five character in each series).
